subject: Quarter kickoff — Methods Council readout: OKR governance & metrics gate
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quarter kickoff — Methods Council readout: OKR governance & metrics gate

Team,

Attached is the Methods Council readout packet for the Q1 OKR slate: Q1_OKR_Governance_Playbook.pdf and the metrics rubric (metrics_rubric_v3.xlsx). Key asks in this email:

- Review the governance playbook and flag any SLO/measurement mismatches by EOD Monday (12/14).
- Confirm owner commitments for the six measurement gates (inline table in the rubric).
- Approve the proposed escalation path for measurement failures (page 4).

Background: the council agreed to a tightened measurement window (14d rolling) to reduce noise during launch. This impacts Dedicated capacity QoS benchmarks — I want a quick ops feasibility check from Kar (cc'd).

Agenda highlights for the sync on Tuesday 12/15 10:00–10:30 PT (calendar invite sent):
- Playbook readout (5m)
- Measurement gate sign-off (10m)
- Owner commitments / roll-forward plan (10m)
- Risks & mitigation (5m)

Please use the Drive link for a single source of truth: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Q1_okr_playbook

Thanks — brief replies welcome ("accept" / "needs change" / "defer") so I can consolidate before the council meeting.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q1_OKR_Governance_Playbook.pdf (document), Methods_Council_Agenda.docx (doc), metrics_rubric_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — Methods Council readout: OKR governance & metrics gate

Mina — quick read, thanks for the packet. My notes:

- Measurement window: 14d rolling makes sense for surface metrics. For tail-latency (%ile99) I recommend a 30d complementary window to smooth launch spikes.
- Dedicated capacity QoS: the playbook assumes autoscale tolerance of 300ms; our current kernel selection has a 200ms warm-start variance. Ops needs to approve or we revert to conservative targets.
- Suggestion: add a short clause about fallback model routing when a measurement gate flips to "failed" — we don't want customer-facing downtime while remediation runs.

I've added inline comments and uploaded Karthik_comments.md to the Drive. Naomi — tagging you for the measurements thresholds (I put proposed numbers inline).

Will try to be on the 12/15 call but may be delayed by infra reviews.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Karthik_comments.md (text)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — Methods Council readout: OKR governance & metrics gate

Thanks — read through. A few operational clarifications:

- I agree with the 14d rolling for signal detection BUT we should gate any SLA-linked incentives behind a 28d stabilization period. Otherwise we risk premature rollbacks.
- Staging evaluation: recommend a mandatory staging-run (48–72h, production traffic replay) before we flip any measurement gates for customer-impacting objectives.
- Dedicated capacity flag: ops can support the 300ms target if we include a temporary burst reserve of one node per pool for week-0 traffic. That will increase cost ~5% but avoids a false positive on gate failure.

I'm okay with the playbook once the staging clause and reserve nodes are added. Happy to add the wording on page 5.

- Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Li <rachel@brightedge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — Methods Council readout: OKR governance & metrics gate

Mina / Marissa,

Thanks for sharing the playbook. From BrightEdge's side: our legal/procurement team needs acknowledgment that measurement gate failures will not automatically trigger billing adjustments until a joint ops review completes (we expect a 5–7 business day window). If that matches your escalation flow, we can sign the SLA addendum next week.

Timeline: procurement@brightedge.com can start paperwork the week of 12/20 provided we sign off the playbook on 12/15–12/16.

Happy to discuss on the 12/15 call if needed.

Best,
Rachel Li
VP Product, BrightEdge

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com, rachel@brightedge.com, sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — Methods Council readout: OKR governance & metrics gate

Looping procurement and legal signals: BrightEdge's ask for a 5–7 business day review matches how we plan to operate the escalation path — the playbook calls for a joint ops review window before any billing or quota changes are enacted. I'll coordinate with Legal to prepare a short SLA rider that captures the joint-review language and the staging-run requirement Naomi mentioned.

Question for the council: do we want to include an explicit "bypass" for P0 incidents where rollback is immediate? I think we should — otherwise customers could be left exposed during live incidents.

I will bring a draft SLA rider to the 12/15 call.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success & Programs
Redwood Inference

- Outstanding: Kar to confirm whether kernel warm-start variance requires an ops config change (expected update during call).
- External: Rachel — noted. Marissa will present the SLA rider and procurement timeline on the call; BrightEdge procurement tentatively ready week of 12/20.

Please mark your calendar for the 10:00 PT sync. If you cannot attend, reply with "accept" to indicate sign-off or "needs change: <short note>" so I can record in the readout.
